name: read_logic_many
description: Read up to 256 generic logic values in one main-thread request. Each operation returns its own result, by index: {index, ok, reference_id, logic_type, value}, or on failure {index, ok: false, reference_id, logic_type, error: {code, message}} where reference_id and logic_type are null when the entry's own could not be read.

reference_id.description: Target device reference ID returned by list_devices.

logic_type.description: LogicType enum name or numeric ushort ID.
